sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared benchmarking library notes still omit parity-pair gate semantics (ag/rust-ag hard gate vs cross-tool divergence advisory).
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/benchmarking.md includes comparator set and artifact controls, but not parity-pair correctness behavior reflected in benchmarks/correctness_gate.py and prior review findings.
